steps.title: Roll explicit core
steps.action: Use Deafening Essence of Greed on the rare Grizzly Pelt.
steps.continueWhen: Life at least 100, native suppression, Cold Resistance at least 21% and an open prefix. This selects the cold-resistance variant of the research benchmark.
steps.failureAction: Repeat paid Greed if any requirement is missing; previous explicit modifiers and bench craft are lost. Eldritch implicits remain.

steps.title: Craft exactly 10% AoE
steps.action: Bench craft +1 socketed AoE Gems / 8–10% increased Area of Effect for 4 Chaos. Inspect the numeric AoE.
steps.continueWhen: Exactly 10% AoE and +1 socketed AoE gems.
steps.failureAction: For 8% or 9%, use the Crafting Bench Remove Crafted Mods action for one Orb of Scouring, then repeat this 4 Chaos craft. Do not apply a Scouring Orb directly.

steps.title: Conditional bench recovery
steps.action: Only when the prior AoE bench roll is 8% or 9%, use Crafting Bench Remove Crafted Mods.
steps.continueWhen: Rolled life, suppression and resistance remain; return to the AoE bench step.
steps.failureAction: Stop if removing the bench would touch an unexpected protected state. This action is conditional, not paid on an initial 10% success.

steps.title: Roll mana efficiency
steps.action: Use Lesser Eldritch Embers until unconditional Mana Cost Efficiency is at least 26%.
steps.continueWhen: Unconditional increased Mana Cost Efficiency at least 26%.
steps.failureAction: Repeat Embers; reject conditional boss/unique variants. Only the Exarch implicit rerolls.

steps.title: Roll lightning conversion
steps.action: Use Lesser Eldritch Ichors until at least 6% of Physical Damage from Hits is taken as Lightning Damage.
steps.continueWhen: Unconditional physical hit damage taken as Lightning at least 6%.
steps.failureAction: Repeat Ichors; only the Eater implicit rerolls.
